capabilities: Create links that copy embedded text to the clipboard via the obsidian://copy protocol
Insert a copy-protocol link from the current clipboard content with a command or hotkey
Encode text with spaces or special characters automatically
Preview the text a link will copy by hovering with Ctrl or Cmd held
extras: Installation via the BRAT beta plugin installer is documented, suggesting the plugin may not yet be widely published; the author notes Outlook query strings as their main use case.
motivation: The author's primary use case is pasting query strings into other apps such as Outlook, and notes like cheat sheets with commands, passwords, and templates.
problem: Obsidian links open notes or URIs but there is no built-in way for a link click to place arbitrary reusable text onto the clipboard.
summary: Utility plugin that registers an obsidian://copy protocol so clicking a link silently copies embedded text, commands, or templates to the clipboard.
